nuggets.text: Falcons coach Eddie George beat Nebraska's Tommie Frazier for the 1995 Heisman Trophy by just 264 votes.
Defensive end Eriq George plays for his dad, Falcons head coach Eddie George.
Eddie George spent six weeks on Broadway in 2016 playing lawyer Billy Flynn in the musical Chicago.
Eddie George joined Jim Brown as the only NFL backs to rush for 10,000 yards without ever missing a start.
Jay Kastantin went from Division II Assumption to Falcons starter and completed 24 of 30 passes in his debut.
Pudge, a long snapper's exotic shorthair Persian, became the Falcons' viral locker-room mascot in 2025.
The Falcons have two mascots: Freddie Falcon and Frieda Falcon.
Urban Meyer got his start as a head coach at Bowling Green, leading the Falcons in 2001 and 2002.
The Falcons went a perfect 9-0 in 1959 and won the UPI small college national championship.
Saturday marks the first-ever meeting between the Falcons and Nebraska.
